composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the vessel's lifting keel and the forward/aft mast winches (port and starboard). This is evidenced by the function slice labels (LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN, LIFTING KEEL LOCKS, MAST WINCH AFT PORT, etc.) which are grouped together on a common mast block hydraulic manifold.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The first two slices are explicitly labelled 'LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN' and 'LIFTING KEEL LOCKS'.

functions.label: LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN
functions.what_it_does: Controls the up and down movement of the lifting keel via a proportional directional valve.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool in open neutral position; P rail is blocked, A and B work lines are bled to T rail via small orifices, and the LS line is drained to the T rail.

Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to B; fluid flows from P rail out port B, upwards through the pilot-operated check valve to the actuator. Return fluid from the actuator opens the A port PO check via pilot pressure from the B line, returning to the T rail. Port B maximum pressure is limited to 220 bar by an inline port relief valve.

Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to A; fluid flows from P rail out port A, upwards through the pilot-operated check valve to the actuator. Return fluid from the actuator opens the B port PO check via pilot pressure from the A line, returning to the T rail. Port A maximum pressure is limited to 60 bar by an inline port relief valve.

functions.dry_data: PVG 32 MODULE, spool 40 lt/min, PVEU - 0-10 V
functions.sheet_region: Slice EV-6.1, left side of the active block

functions.label: LIFTING KEEL LOCKS
functions.what_it_does: Controls the locking mechanism for the lifting keel via an on/off directional valve.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool in closed neutral position; P, A, and B ports are blocked; the load-sense (LS) signal is vented to tank.
Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to A; flow goes out port A to the actuator and returns from port B to the T rail. Pressure on port A is limited to 100 bar by its relief valve.
Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to B; flow goes out port B to the actuator and returns from port A to the T rail. Pressure on port B is limited to 100 bar by its relief valve.

functions.dry_data: PVG 32 MODULE, spool 5 lt/min, PVEO - ON/OFF

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.3 is labelled 'MAST WINCH AFT PORT'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH AFT PORT
functions.what_it_does: Directs hydraulic flow to drive the aft port mast winch in 1st/3rd gear or 2nd gear.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool in open neutral position; P is blocked, A and B work ports are open to the T return rail.

Pilot module shifts spool to direct flow from P through the compensator to port A. Return flow from port B is directed to tank T. Maximum pressure on port A is limited to 250 bar by the shock/anti-cavitation valve.

Pilot module shifts spool to direct flow from P through the compensator to port B. Return flow from port A is directed to tank T. Maximum pressure on port B is limited to 225 bar by the shock/anti-cavitation valve.
If pressure at port A or B drops below tank pressure, anti-cavitation check valves allow makeup fluid to flow from the T rail into the respective work port.

functions.dry_data: PVG 32 MODULE, spool 65 lt/min, PVED - ON/OFF

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.4 is labelled 'MAST WINCH FWD PORT'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH FWD PORT
functions.what_it_does: Directs hydraulic flow to drive the fwd port mast winch in 1st/3rd gear or 2nd gear.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool in open neutral position; P is blocked, A and B work ports are open to the T return rail.
Pilot module shifts spool to direct pressure flow from P to port A. Return flow from port B is directed to tank T. Port A maximum pressure is limited to 250 bar by the shock/anti-cavitation valve.
Pilot module shifts spool to direct pressure flow from P to port B. Return flow from port A is directed to tank T. Port B maximum pressure is limited to 225 bar by the shock/anti-cavitation valve.
Anti-cavitation check valves draw fluid from the T rail to replenish work ports A or B if pressure drops below tank line pressure.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice EV-6.5 is labelled 'MAST WINCH AFT STBD'.

functions.label: MAST WINCH AFT STBD
functions.what_it_does: Directs hydraulic flow to drive the aft stbd mast winch in 1st/3rd gear or 2nd gear.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool in open neutral position; P is blocked, A and B work ports are open to the T return rail.

Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to A; flow is regulated by the upstream pressure compensator. Return flow from port B connects to T. Pressure on port A is limited to 250 bar by the shock/anti-cavitation relief valve.
Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to B. Return flow from port A connects to T. Pressure on port B is limited to 225 bar by the shock/anti-cavitation relief valve.
Anti-cavitation check valves draw fluid from the T rail to replenish work ports A or B if pressure drops below tank line pressure.

functions.label: MAST WINCH FWD STBD
functions.what_it_does: Directs hydraulic flow to drive the fwd stbd mast winch in 1st/3rd gear or 2nd gear.

flow_scenarios.path: Spool in open neutral position; P and LS lines are connected to T.
Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to port A. Return flow from port B connects to the T rail. Port A pressure is limited to 230 bar by an inline relief valve.
Pilot module shifts spool to connect P to port B. Return flow from port A connects to the T rail. Port B pressure is limited to 225 bar by an inline relief valve.

facts: Provides common P, T, LSA, and LSB rails to all six function slices on the sheet.
Includes an inlet section block with a standalone auxiliary valve at the left edge.
Includes a closing end plate at the right edge.
